name: Kirkland Signature Deli Chicken Quesadillas with Salsa & Guacamole
whyItWorks: Flour tortillas filled with shredded chicken breast and mild cheddar/jack cheese. Heating on a dry skillet creates a warm, soft meal with gentle protein and carbs.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Cook on a skillet until cheese melts. Skip the side salsa and sour cream if sensitive to spice and dairy.
